purpose: Teach: ちがう/浮い/曲げ/騒い/脱い/滑り/冷やし/返せ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の答え、本気で、絶対、ちがう、絶対、よ
lines.en: Riku, your answer is seriously, completely wrong.
lines.style: Sharp, accusatory bite on the opening. Clipped pacing. That particular teen contempt—but underneath it, genuine exasperation that he's being difficult on purpose.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、プールで、本気で、絶対、浮い、絶対、てたな、桜
lines.en: You were seriously floating around in the pool like that, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick, bright deflection. Lean into the absurdity—playful mimic of her stance. Almost teasing, with just enough edge to suggest he's dodging her real point.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の指、本気で、絶対、曲げ、絶対、過ぎだぜ
lines.en: Riku, you were seriously bending your fingers way too much.
lines.style: Flat, matter-of-fact call-out. Let the observation land without performance. Wry half-smile in the voice—she's documenting his ridiculousness for the record.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、騒い、絶対、で、絶対、先生に怒られたぜ、桜
lines.en: You were seriously making such a racket the teacher yelled at us, Sakura.
lines.style: Accusatory lean-back. Build on 'rowdy'—make it clear he's not taking responsibility. Quick, almost whiny defense, but with just enough self-awareness to know it's petty.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、体育で、本気で、絶対、脱い、絶対、だ、絶対、ジャージ、絶対、忘れたよ
lines.en: Riku, you seriously forgot your gym uniform.
lines.style: Flat, cutting statement. No sympathy. Short pause before delivering the final fact—let her watch him realise she's right. Barely suppressed smile.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、駅で、本気で、絶対、滑り、絶対、転んだろ?桜
lines.en: Didn't you seriously slip and fall at the station, Sakura?
lines.style: Rising challenge at the end—it's a taunt wrapped in a question. Lighter, almost gleeful. He knows she knows he saw it. Quick, bright delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、ペットボトル、本気で、絶対、冷やし、絶対、ておいてよ
lines.en: Riku, seriously go put that bottle in the fridge.
lines.style: Direct command, no room for negotiation. Casual authority—she's moved on from the argument. Quick, practical. Sounds almost like she's doing him a favour by telling him what to do.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、返せ、絶対、よ、絶対、漫画、絶対、貸したろ?桜
lines.en: You seriously need to give back that manga I lent you, Sakura.
lines.style: Firm, businesslike. Builds on the grievance—he's been sitting on it. Quick snap on 'return', then a slight slow-down on the favour he did her. Almost exasperated, like she has to manage him.
